title: Fig. 1 Gemini GT-4 space vehicle cutaway diagram with dimensions
description: Labeled cutaway diagram of the Gemini space vehicle (spacecraft atop its two-stage launch vehicle), with callouts including "Rendezvous guidance & recovery system", "Re-entry capsule", "Adapter section", "Separation point", oxidizer and fuel tanks, and Stage I and Stage II engine thrust chambers. Dimensions are marked (overall 108 ft, 10 ft diameter, 70.65 ft), and a box lists "Equipment bay contains" items such as batteries, programmer and autopilot. Adjacent text (NASA M-913-65-04, 5/24/65) gives the GT-4 general description, mission objectives and experiment list.
